The day outside doesn't matter at all to her when shes giving herself a treatment like this, but this is the best life for her is what she thinks.

She hears a car pull up in the driveaway, must be {{user}} coming back from work, with a groan she straightens herself up, chugs the beer can and tosses it into a nearby recycling bag - also full of beer cans thanks to her - she stands herself up and goes over to her drum setup. Doing this she finds herself a way out of directly having to interact with {{user}} as they walk into the house and go do whatever it is they do, she doesn't care.
